programme.desc: Sally Mae Hassona grew up in Australia.When she was very young, she started training kickboxing, then football, and in 2012 she became interested in boxing.That's how she got into the amateur league.As a talented player, she won the Golden Gloves Championship.Some time later she became a trainer.Together with her Egyptian husband, they are the parents of two children.They moved to Cairo four years ago.Women's boxing is a completely new phenomenon in this city.Society often cannot accept that women practice this "men's sport".However, Sally Mae Hassona decided to start her own boxing academy: Impact Sports Academy.There he trains girls and boys from poor families.She also hopes that in the future, her students' fighting skills will enable them to defend themselves against violence.Some of Sally's students successfully participate in competitions organized by the federation in Egypt.The woman's children also train, and her son became a boxing champion.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska once again managed to reach the titular "end of the world", despite restrictions, difficulties in traveling, and the fact that the thirteenth series of the program could have been the unlucky one.During the uncertain time of the pandemic, she showed viewers moving stories that gave hope that miracles can be achieved even in the most difficult circumstances.She produced an extraordinary series of stories from Dubai, Georgia, Kenya, Malawi, Egypt and Romania.Now viewers will learn the behind-the-scenes of all these expeditions.For the host of the program, it is also a sentimental journey - one of the heroines of the reports, Raha Moharrak, just like her, reached for the Crown of the Earth, and in the desert in Dubai, Martyna Wojciechowska met her colleagues from the Dakar Rally: Marek Dąbrowski and Jacek Czachor.In Kenya, she appeared in a music video for a gospel song by Darlan Rukish.However, during filming in Malawi, she refused to eat a roasted mouse.This is just some of the information that will appear in the episode.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: The program returns to the air after a break.Over the last few months, Martyna Wojciechowska and her team have traveled all over the world to look for inspiring women who will talk about what is currently most important.For some topics, the host had to wait many years, but for the good stuff, it's definitely worth it.The latest season will bring meetings with the oldest and youngest heroines in the history of the show.Viewers will see episodes shot in eight countries and on five continents.However, it is not about records or the number of kilometers traveled.The most important thing is meeting another person, time spent together, intimate conversation, and the truth about the world The whole world heard about Anja Ringgren Loven in 2016.All because of a photo showing a woman giving water to an extremely exhausted two-year-old who was close to death in a Nigerian village.The boy accused of witchcraft was driven out of his home.He wandered for a long time before help arrived.In Nigeria, they still believe in magic and use it to explain all misfortunes and accidents.People living in poverty and deprived of the opportunity for education may, under the pretext of accusing them of witchcraft, get rid of another person to feed from their home.Martyna Wojciechowska's heroine, Anja, has been active in this country for years.She founded the "Land of Hope" organization, which deals with rescuing and providing a safe haven for children suspected of being associated with evil forces.

programme.title: It's beautiful here
programme.desc: Dorota Szelągowska will visit unique places in Poland, the existence of which only insiders often know.The host will prove that it is never too late to fulfill your childhood dream and live in a tree house, at least for a while.For those who value greater comfort, he will show luxurious interiors created, among others, by:in an old cotton fabric factory.Viewers will also meet the owners of these charming places, who will tell their stories and reveal how they managed to implement their unique plans and projects.Many of them abandoned life in big cities to be able to do what they love most, i.e. interior design and running unique guesthouses.Dorota Szelągowska will look into every nook and cranny of these original objects, reveal interior design ideas to the viewers and prove that there are many wonderful places in Poland that are truly beautiful. Dorota Szelągowska visits Pabianice.Thanks to many years of revitalization works, the former building of a cotton fabric factory now houses the "Fabryka Wełny" hotel.The presenter will assess the effect of the designers' efforts, who had to combine modern design with elements reflecting the past of this place.At the same time, they could not forget about comfortable conditions for guests.Then Dorota Szelągowska will try the dishes served in the hotel restaurant and talk to the musicians working there.

programme.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programme.desc: Pascal Brodnicki likes to explore the world through his sense of taste.He loves to prepare various dishes at street stalls, in African villages or on the beach. However, during his culinary journeys it was not always easy for him.Sometimes elephants stole his ingredients.Of course, Pascal couldn't deny himself the pleasure of tasting local delicacies.In Delhi, he stopped for a long time at a paratha stand, in a Zanzibar village he ate rice with coconut, and in Namibia he tried a zebra steak."Taste the world with Pascal" is not only about cooking.The host visited an elephant orphanage in Sri Lanka, fed cheetahs in Africa and climbed a coconut tree.In Bombay he became a teacher and taught Polish to children, and on the coast of Zanzibar he hunted octopus.Everywhere his passion and positive energy attracted crowds of onlookers.

programme.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programme.desc: Pascal will visit Algeria - a culinary melting pot born from the combination of Berber, Bedouin and French cuisine.The journey begins in Algiers, where he learns about local delicacies and goes shopping at the oldest market in the capital.Use them to make an eggplant and meat apple pie.In the evening, in a confectionery shop with sweets, he learns what their secret is.Pascal's next stop is Bou Sada.The cook, together with Rashid and his family, prepares a traditional snack - sveti.Then he goes to the largest dromedary farm to learn the secret of camel milk.

programme.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programme.desc: Pascal continues his journey through Algeria.In Tipaza he goes out to sea to collect nets.Then, grilled fish with vegetable sauce is prepared on the shore in the company of a crowd of passers-by.Then Pascal finds the oldest shop selling dates and finds out why they are so popular.The cook is invited to a spontaneous party with local decision-makers and journalists.Unfortunately, the next day Pascal has an accident, tears his ankle ligament and damages the joint capsule.However, he does not give up and returns to cooking the next day.Pea soup with spices is made in a palm grove.And for dessert, thousand-hole pancakes with date jam.

programme.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programme.desc: Cameras visit the clove plantations for which Zanzibar is famous.Viewers will discover how they are grown, harvested and dried, as well as how the best spices are selected.The cook Habiba will reveal the secrets of traditional dishes of this country, and at the same time Pascal will find out what the women of Zanzibar think about men who get involved in cooking.A healer from a friendly village will tell the host about the healing properties of cloves.Finally, Pascal will show you how to combine colorful African cuisine with Polish flavors and prepare a simple chicken curry in coconut milk.He will also explain why he loves one-pot meals.

programme.title: Luxury embassies
programme.desc: Holidays in the Maldives mean, above all, the beauty of nature.The ocean delights with the transparency of its azure waters, sandy beaches encourage you to relax on the golden sand, green palm trees enchant with their exotic nature.Traveler Justyna Adamczyk will visit the most exclusive hotels in the world.The price of accommodation in some of them reaches the cost of a mid-class car.Only specialists work in these places;professional designers, cuisine and wine experts.They make sure that guests lack nothing and can fully enjoy their vacation.The host will visit the most luxurious apartments on coral reefs with retractable roofs.He will see a cinema located in the middle of the ocean and a restaurant located six meters below its surface.There is also a wine collection and golf courses watered with desalinated sea water.The expert will also meet the people who designed all these wonders.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska goes to Pakistan, where she meets members of the Kalash tribe.They are the only non-Muslim community in this country, the last descendants of the inhabitants of ancient Kafiristan, who inhabit the lands located on the border of today's Pakistan and Afghanistan.Only about four thousand of them survived.Kalaska women choose their own husbands, and when they do not treat them well or the relationship does not work out, they leave to look for a new partner.Free relationships are also allowed among the Kalash, which are prohibited in any other Pakistani community.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska reaches La Paz.Bolivian women have played a primarily reproductive role for centuries.They are caregivers in their families, dependent on men in every aspect of life.If they do not want to comply, they may be beaten.It is in Bolivia that the rate of violence against women remains the highest in all of South America.Meanwhile, some of them decided to fight stereotypes and exchange chef's aprons for crayfish and then conquer the peaks.Martyna Wojciechowska meets such people.They belong to the cholit climbing team from La Paz, led by its founder, Alicia.In this episode, the traveler will also visit Carmen Rojas, the heroine of the first season of the program.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: This time the destination is Belgium, Brussels - the very heart of the European Union.Martyna Wojciechowska manages, among others,to one of the capital's districts, Molenbeek, where he talks to the mothers of jihadists.It turns out that more than five thousand people left the Old Continent, and more than five hundred people left Belgium itself.They all left to fight on the side of the so-called Islamic State.We are talking about young people, women and children.The traveler tries to find out why they decided to join a terrorist organization.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: For Martyna Wojciechowska, the most important value is freedom.During her travels in the ninth season of the program, she decided to show what she means to others - her characters.The Malaysian fish people have cut themselves off from civilization.The Kazakh girl breaks all stereotypes and excels in activities reserved only for men.Pakistani Masarrat Misbah, thanks to her courage, is changing the world, restoring freedom to others.Kalashka Iran Bibi lives according to the centuries-old tradition of his ancestors despite external pressures.In Japan, Martyna Wojciechowska found people free from any prejudices.However, sometimes honest conversations bring further questions - about the price that Bolivian cholitas pay for their independence;about whether jihadist mothers could limit the freedom of their children, and whether Mennonites are making the right choice by consciously deciding on a life limited by rigid rules.
